title: Conditional Deep Levy Models for Exotic Derivatives: History-Aware Path Generation and P-Q Payoff Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2509.13374v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a history-aware equity-index path generator based on Denoising Levy Probabilistic Models (DLPMs) and evaluate its predictive distributions through path-dependent derivative payoffs. A conditional U-Net combines contract state, index identity, 60- and 252-day return histories, and financial regularization with coordinate-wise stable mixing. A matched experiment holds initialization, training data, batch order, objective, computational budget and evaluation checkpoint fixed while comparing $\alpha=1.9$ with the Gaussian limit $\alpha=2$. On 6,824 chronological windows from eight Chinese and U.S. indices, terminal CRPS falls from 0.050585 to 0.048031, a 5.05% reduction, and path energy improves by 4.03%. The paired 60-calendar-day CRPS interval is [-0.004022, -0.001298]. Coverage rises from 56.68% to 71.00% while the proper 90% interval score improves by 20.30%. translated_title: 用于奇异衍生品的条件深度列维模型：历史感知路径生成与P-Q收益诊断
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个基于去噪列维概率模型（DLPM）的具有历史感知能力的股指路径生成器，并通过路径依赖的衍生品收益来评估其预测分布。一个条件U-Net结合了合约状态、指数标识、60天和252天的收益率历史，以及采用坐标级稳定混合的金融正则化。在一个匹配实验中，我们保持初始化、训练数据、批次顺序、目标函数、计算预算和评估检查点全部固定不变，比较α=1.9与高斯极限α=2的表现。在来自八个中美股指的6,824个按时间顺序排列的窗口上，终端CRPS从0.050585降至0.048031，降低了5.05%，路径能量提升了4.03%。配对的60个自然日CRPS区间为[-0.004022, -0.001298]。覆盖率从56.68%上升至71.00%，同时适当的90%区间评分提升了20.30%。经验基准仍然具有竞争力：全池…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于去噪列维概率模型的条件式历史感知股指路径生成器，通过严格控制变量的匹配实验证明，列维稳定参数α=1.9相比高斯极限α=2在路径依赖衍生品收益诊断（CRPS、覆盖率、区间评分等指标）上取得显著改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a conditional, history-aware equity-index path generator based on Denoising Levy Probabilistic Models, demonstrating through strictly controlled matched experiments that a Levy setting with α=1.9 significantly outperforms the Gaussian limit α=2 across path-dependent derivative payoff diagnostics including CRPS, coverage, and interval scores.
